checkedAlternates.resolution: Pu-erh undergoes microbial post-fermentation (hei cha, group-1), distinct from enzymatic polyphenol oxidation in black/oolong teas (group-4).

checkedAlternates.resolution: White teas are withered and dried without pan-firing or steaming kill-green (group-2), unlike unoxidized green teas (group-3).
